name: knob
title: Knob
description: Rotary encoder dial with circular milled bezel, tick marks, physical indicator line, mouse drag/wheel/keyboard physics, and telemetry readout.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial numeric value for uncontrolled mode

props.name: onChange
props.description: Value update callback during drag, scroll, or keyboard adjustments

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of rotary encoder dial in pixels

props.name: variant
props.description: Depth tier styling of dial bezel and face

props.name: showTicks
props.description: Renders radial tick marks around dial circumference

props.name: showValue
props.description: Renders recessed digital value readout pill

examples.title: Rotary Telemetry Dial
examples.description: Tactile milled encoder with radial tick marks and numerical readout.
examples.code:
<Knob
  label="Master Gain"
  defaultValue={64}
  min={0}
  max={100}
  unit="%"
  variant="tactile"
/>
